task: Fix bank.py transfer: positive amounts move funds only when the source can cover them. Insufficient funds and nonpositive amounts raise ValueError and leave both accounts unchanged. A transfer to the same account must be a no-op after validation.

edits.old:
accounts[source] -= amount
    if accounts[source] < 0:
        raise ValueError("insufficient funds")
    accounts[target] += amount
edits.new:
if amount <= 0 or accounts[source] < amount:
        raise ValueError("invalid transfer")
    accounts[source] -= amount
    accounts[target] += amount

answer: Fixed the requested behavior and preserved other behavior.
